title: Steak Kebabs with Chimichurri
description: Skewered steak and red onion grilled to a char, finished with a bright parsley-garlic chimichurri.
ingredients: 500 g flank or sirloin steak, cubed
steps: Thread the steak, onion and tomatoes onto skewers.
Grill 8-10 minutes, turning, until cooked to your liking.
Blend the parsley, garlic, vinegar and oil into chimichurri, and spoon over the skewers.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste steak kebabs with chimichurri

notes: Cutting the steak into even cubes means everything on the skewer cooks at the same rate.
